locations.name: Sa Fonda
locations.description: Deià's beloved village tapas bar — rustic, wine-forward, flavor-packed small plates in a cozy, almost family-like room that turns bustling and energetic in the evenings. Manus's pick as your walk-in 'neighborhood spot' for the Deià leg: the Barcelona Wine Bar of the village, steps from La Residencia.
locations.address: Carrer Arxiduc Luís Salvador, 5, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Barcelona Wine Bar match for Deià: the village's beloved tapas bar — rustic, wine-forward small plates, cozy family-like atmosphere, bustling in the evenings. Walk-in friendly; 'your neighborhood spot during the Deià leg.'

locations.name: Restaurante Deià
locations.description: Simple, honest, home-cooked Mallorcan food in Deià village — local white wine, stuffed peppers, squid. Manus's second Barcelona-Wine-Bar-adjacent pick for the Deià leg: 'not fancy but deeply satisfying,' the low-key counterweight to the El Olivo/Bens d'Avall splurges.
locations.address: Carrer Felipe Bauzà, 1, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Local white wine, stuffed peppers, squid — the rustic, home-cooked Mallorcan vibe with excellent local wines. 'Simple, honest food. Not fancy but deeply satisfying.'

locations.name: Xoriguer
locations.description: Palma institution since the 1980s in Santa Catalina — Mediterranean-Basque cooking with grilled meats, a warm rustic room, and an outstanding, reasonably priced wine list (the sirloin with Mallorca wine is legendary; 9.2/10 on TheFork). Manus's #1 pick as 'probably your single closest match to Barcelona Wine Bar.' Around the corner from Santa Catalina Market; reserve about a week out for weekend nights (OpenTable).
locations.address: C. de la Fàbrica, 60, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Top-3 pick #1: 'probably your single closest match to Barcelona Wine Bar' — Mediterranean-Basque grilled meats, outstanding reasonably-priced wine list, warm rustic atmosphere; sirloin with Mallorca wine is legendary. 9.2/10 TheFork; reserve ~a week ahead for Fri/Sat.

locations.geocode_query: Restaurante Xoriguer, Santa Catalina, Palma de Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Tast Club
locations.description: Hidden tapas bar tucked inside a vaulted-ceiling courtyard mansion off Carrer de Sant Jaume — excellent cocktails, a carefully curated wine list, and elevated tapas at fair prices. 'Brimming with romance': Manus's most-romantic pick of the wine-bar set and a natural Palma date night. Reserve about a week out for weekends.
locations.address: Carrer de Sant Jaume, 6, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Top-3 pick #2: hidden tapas bar in a vaulted-ceiling courtyard mansion — excellent cocktails, curated wine list, elevated tapas. 'Brimming with romance.' Perfect date night; reserve ~a week ahead for Fri/Sat.

locations.geocode_query: Tast Club, Palma de Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: La Vinya de Santa Clara
locations.description: Tiny, owner-run wine bar on Carrer de Santa Clara with 60+ wines by the glass, Spanish charcuterie, cheeses and simple tapas — the owner personally walks you through the pours. 'Feels like discovering a secret,' away from the tourist hustle: the ideal pre-dinner wine stop or light evening in the Old Town.
locations.address: Carrer de Santa Clara, 8, 07001 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Tiny owner-run wine bar, 60+ wines by the glass, charcuterie and simple tapas; the owner personally guides the tasting. 'Very intimate — feels like discovering a secret.' Great pre-dinner stop.

locations.geocode_query: La Vinya de Santa Clara, Palma de Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Bar Día
locations.description: Truly rustic local tapas bar on Carrer dels Apuntadors — grilled padrón peppers, croquettes, tortilla, good local wines, about €42 for dinner for two with wine. 'The most authentic neighborhood bar on this list. No frills, just great food and wine.' A few doors from El Camino, so the street makes an easy high-low tapas crawl.
locations.address: Carrer dels Apuntadors, 18, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Rustic local tapas bar — padrón peppers, croquettes, tortilla, local wines; ~€42 dinner for two with wine. 'The most authentic neighborhood bar on this list.'

locations.geocode_query: Bar Dia, Carrer dels Apuntadors, Palma de Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Rostei
locations.description: Family-run since 1991 in an 1849 building in Begur's village center, with a wisteria-shaded terrace — grilled meats, grilled clams, and a warm, rustic room. Manus's 'Barcelona Wine Bar equivalent in Costa Brava' and top-3 pick #3: the roasted-chicken-and-wine energy you love, walkable from a Begur base. Joins the already-dense Begur dinner cluster (Casa Juanita, Clara, Can Climent).
locations.address: Carrer de la Concepció Pi Tató, 8, 17255 Begur, Girona, Spain

references.note: Top-3 pick #3: family-run since 1991, 1849 building, wisteria-shaded terrace; grilled meats and clams, warm rustic atmosphere. 'Your neighborhood grill in Begur.' Ranked #10 in Begur on TripAdvisor.

locations.name: El Tapas de Begur
locations.description: Authentic, no-fuss tapas bar on Begur's Plaça de la Vila — simple, quick and friendly, the pop-in spot for a glass of wine and a few plates before or after dinner in the village. 'More casual/quick-bite than Barcelona Wine Bar, but the same tapas-bar soul.'
locations.address: Plaça de la Vila, 4, 17255 Begur, Girona, Spain

references.note: Authentic tapas bar in the village center — simple, quick, friendly; the pre/post-dinner wine-and-plates stop. Same tapas-bar soul as Barcelona Wine Bar, more casual.

locations.geocode_query: El Tapas de Begur, Begur, Girona, Spain

locations.name: Vinilo Wine Bar & Bistro
locations.description: Natural/biodynamic wine bar and bistro right by the sea in L'Escala, with homemade food from local produce and a curated vinyl soundtrack — intimate and artisanal. The most wine-forward option on the Costa Brava per Manus, but a ~35-minute drive north of Begur, so it suits an Empordà/L'Escala day (anchovy country) rather than a casual evening.
locations.address: Carrer Port d'en Perris, 2, 17130 L'Escala, Girona, Spain

references.note: Natural/biodynamic wines, homemade food from local produce, curated vinyl soundtrack, right by the sea. 'The most wine-forward option on the Costa Brava' — worth the drive/taxi.

locations.geocode_query: Vinilo Wine Bar, L'Escala, Girona, Spain

locations.name: Entre Dos Mons
locations.description: Michelin-Guide-recognized Peruvian-Catalan fusion in Palamós with an incredible wine list built on small Empordà producers — the owner personally introduces bottles you'd never find elsewhere. 'More elevated than Barcelona Wine Bar, but the same passion for wine discovery and bold flavors.' 20 minutes from Begur, on the same street as Kaos — and a natural dinner after a Palamós boat-charter day.
locations.address: Carrer de Tauler i Servià, 21, 17230 Palamós, Girona, Spain

references.note: Michelin-recognized Peruvian-Catalan fusion; incredible wine list of small Empordà producers; charming hosts who personally introduce the wines. More elevated, same wine-discovery passion.

locations.geocode_query: Entre Dos Mons, Palamos, Girona, Spain

locations.name: El Camino
locations.description: A bustling, high-end tapas bar on Carrer dels Apuntadors with a long counter and open kitchen, from the team behind London's Barrafina. Manus's wine-bar roundup singles it out as sharing Barcelona Wine Bar's DNA — counter seating, watching chefs work, sharing plates — just more polished. Bar Día, the no-frills cousin, is a few doors down the same street.
locations.address: Carrer dels Apuntadors, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'More polished than Barcelona Wine Bar but the same DNA — counter seating, watching chefs work, sharing plates.' Barrafina-team pedigree, bustling energy, excellent Spanish wines.

locations.name: Bar La Sang
locations.description: A brilliant natural-wine bar pouring earthy Mallorcan reds alongside tapas like burrata and anchovies — intimate and wine-geek-friendly. Manus's wine-bar roundup adds: perfect if you love discovering small-producer wines.
locations.address: Carrer d'Antoni Frontera, 22, 07004 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'A brilliant natural wine bar serving earthy Mallorcan reds alongside tapas like burrata and anchovies. Intimate, wine-geek-friendly. Perfect if you love discovering small-producer wines.'
